A '''Patitite''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Nomad Droids" /> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{FactFile2014|25|GAL 1-4|Adi Gallia}}</ref>

==Biography==
This [[Patitite/Legends|Patitite]] lived on Patitite Pattuna when [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] crash-landed on it during the [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Battle of Patitite Pattuna]]. After the two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] accidentally [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Patitites leader, [[Hay-Zu/Legends|the Big Hay-Zu]], the Patitites wanted C-3PO to be their new leader.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

C-3PO refused and told them to [[Democracy/Legends|choose]] a leader from their own [[Species/Legends|species]], and asked them to send forward the three smartest, most intelligent, most understanding and most compassionate individuals. This individual was one of those three, but the Patitites could not choose between them and a [[Unarmed combat/Legends|fight]] broke out. C-3PO and R2-D2 then quickly left the planet.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />
